title: Sentinels of Ether: reverse-engineered craft need psionic assets to fly

tellings.quote: Like getting that to fly requires the psionic assets to lock in again on the ground

plain: Craft that have been reverse engineered, meaning taken apart and copied from non-human originals, can only be flown if "psionic assets" on the ground, people said to use psychic abilities, mentally "lock in" on them. Michels gives this as the account of a man named Jake Barber, drawing on the book Sentinels of Ether. If true, it would mean these craft depend on the mind as much as on machinery.
